respuesta: CUPMem handles older memories at write time via state adjudication rather than at retrieval time. An LLM adjudicator assigns each candidate old state one of four labels — KEEP, STALE, REPLACE, or UNKNOWN [2605.06527#s15.p1]. Stale states are archived rather than deleted, and slots without a settled replacement are marked UNKNOWN_CURRENT [2605.06527#s63.p10]. A topology-triggered search then expands invalidation to structurally affected state regions, so propagated conflicts are retired before query time [2605.06527#s15.p1]. At readout, only authorized state is consumed: active items ground answers, stale items serve as historical context, and unresolved slots block unsafe old defaults [2605.06527#s15.p1]. This raises overall accuracy from 8.7% to 68.0% under the same GPT-4o-mini backbone [2605.06527#s15.p1].

pasos.argumento: CUPMem memory update older memories new evidence

respuesta: The two papers disagree on the headline verdict. The preregistered comparison (24 papers, 13 questions) finds no clean winner: the agent-browsed wiki's organization advantage falls below the registered +2.0 threshold (+1.625 judge-averaged on structural_integrity), point-source groundedness parity is fragile (P(mu≥0)=0.660), and the wiki costs ~21× more query tokens (1,651,357 vs 78,093) [2605.18490#s26.p2][2605.18490#s27.p3][2605.18490#s28.p2]. The classroom study (59 questions) instead reports the compiled wiki clearly beating vector RAG overall (9.95 vs 9.05 of 10; grounded 98% vs 81%), with the gap roughly tripling on cross-page questions (1.79 vs 0.62) [2609.25303#s16.p2][2609.25303#s16.p6]. The key factor they identify is serving strategy / whether the wiki arm has a context-selection step that can fail: the classroom wiki has none, so its result reflects the gap between real retrieval and perfect context selection, whereas the agent-browsed wiki pays for its own traversal (up to 30 turns) and can fail at selection [2609.25303#s24.p3][2605.18490#s8.p1]. The classroom authors treat their result as directional rather than general [2609.25303#s24.p3].

pasos.argumento: LLM-compiled wiki versus RAG answer quality
